test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The major aspect of financial inclusion is enabling the flow of credit to small businesses. In pursuance of the announcement in the Union Budget 2015-16, the Micro Units Development finance Agency (MUDRA) was set up and this led to which of the below mentioned schemes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) was launched on 8th April 2015 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• PMMY aims to provide loans up to Rs. 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
 
• The loans under PMMY are classified into three categories: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (Rs. 50,001 to Rs. 5 lakh), and Tarun (Rs. 5,00,001 to Rs. 10 lakh).
 
• MUDRA (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency) provides refinance support to Banks / MFIs for lending to micro units.
 
• The scheme promotes entrepreneurship among new generation aspiring youth, targeting both urban and rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MUDRA Bank:**

 
 
• Set up as a subsidiary of SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India).
 
• Provides funding to the non-corporate small business sector.
 
• Offers refinance to banks and microfinance institutions (MFIs) that provide loans to micro units.
 
 
 
• **Financial Inclusion:**
 
 
• Aims to ensure access to financial services and timely and adequate credit where needed by vulnerable groups.
 
• Includes initiatives like Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), which provides universal access to banking facilities.
 
 
 
• **Union Budget 2015-16:**
 
 
• Significant focus on financial inclusion and support for small businesses.
 
• Introduced several schemes including PMMY to promote economic growth and support micro-entrepreneurs.
 
 
 
• **Categories of Loans under PMMY:**
 
 
• **Shishu:** Loans up to Rs. 50,000 for starting small businesses.
 
• **Kishore:** Loans between Rs. 50,001 to Rs. 5 lakh for mid-level enterprises.
 
• **Tarun:** Loans between Rs. 5,00,001 to Rs. 10 lakh for established businesses seeking expansion.
